{{Top|leg}}
'''Magnetic couplers''' were employed by [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s as part of their [[Zero-G Assault Stormtrooper Armor Mark II|armor]]. They allowed the spacetrooper to walk on the hulls of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] or similar constructions while in [[Realspace/Legends|space]].
